cache_reuse.reuse_policy: Pinned input/code/cache identity plus mandatory seven-model numerical parity; no pair-sum or cache write.
Pinned input/code/cache identity plus mandatory seven-model numerical parity; no pair-sum or cache write.

limitations: Seven models are a declared sensitivity family, not all possible systematics; existing data motivated this investigation, so discovery claims need calibration of selection/forking paths.
The cached cosmic covariance is reused with its original linear z=0 LCDM, redshift-space geometry and fixed fiducial assumptions; no new pair sum or independent cosmic-model validation is performed.
The 32 compressed multipoles need not be sufficient for the raw 35970-object catalogue model. Information equivalence is tested only on this stated carrier.
Model-specific likelihood ordinates are not compared across differing O_m transforms. No Bayes factor or AIC ranking across the seven experiments is computed.
The block-diagonal covariance calculation is an ablation; the full covariance defines the reported conditional likelihood.
model: eta = nuisance + g(z) n.V + n.dH + n.K.n; X_m = O_m D, C_m = O_m C_noise O_m^T + pinned exact LCDM body

robust.coverage_condition: If one listed nuisance model and its fixed Gaussian covariance law is correct, its 95% ellipsoid is covered by the union. Unknown systematics and selection misspecification are outside this guarantee.
robust.interpretation: Apparent Hubble-rate vector and tensor conditional on the selected CF4 catalogue; V is a coherent velocity component; dH is an apparent log-H dipole, not identified four-acceleration; kappa is an apparent log-H STF tensor, not uniquely cosmological shear.
robust.rule: union over the seven previously evaluated nuisance-model confidence ellipsoids; no model probabilities

simulation.law: 11-dimensional zero-mean Gaussian parameter error with sandwich covariance; fixed design and covariance
